title: AI Companion Manifest
description: Schema for devforgeai/workflows/ai-companion-manifest.json consumed by devforgeai-validate render-ai-companion. Contract grounded in render_ai_companion.py:validate_fragment (lines 237-244) and render_ai_companion.py:1226-1228.

_cache_metadata.description: Informational cache metadata — not validated by the renderer; include for drift-detection and audit trail.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the manifest was generated.

parent_hashes.description: Map of relative parent .md paths to their sha256 hex digests.

agents_invoked.description: Human-readable list of agent invocations that produced this manifest.

companions.description: Map of companion filenames (e.g. 'tech-stack.ai.md') to their fragment objects. Keys must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.ai\.(md|yaml)$.

fragment.description: One fragment produced by ai-rule-extractor for a single parent context file. critical_rules/high_rules required by render_ai_companion.py:validate_fragment (lines 237-241); file existence checked at lines 243-244.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the parent context .md file (e.g. 'devforgeai/specs/context/tech-stack.md'). Must exist on disk at render time (render_ai_companion.py:849).

sha256.description: sha256 hex digest of the parent file content. Include for drift detection. The renderer reads this via .get('sha256', '') and tolerates empty for single-parent companions (render_ai_companion.py:1907).

critical_rules.description: CRITICAL severity rules extracted from the parent file. Must be non-empty if the parent contains SEVERITY: CRITICAL markers (render_ai_companion.py:247-255). Dropping CRITICAL rules violates BR-003.

high_rules.description: HIGH severity rules extracted from the parent file. May be empty.

medium_rules.description: MEDIUM severity rules (optional). Not validated by render_ai_companion.py but included by ai-rule-extractor.

rule_entry.description: A single rule entry within critical_rules, high_rules, or medium_rules. Fields consumed at render_ai_companion.py:1226-1228.

rule.description: Human-readable rule text rendered into the .ai.md companion file.

source_line.description: Line number in the parent file where this rule originates. Optional; rendered as '(line N)' suffix when present.
